chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said: '(What of) the nature of Allah upon which He has created mankind?' He said: 'Divine Unity (Tawheed).'

key_terms.التَّوْحِيد: Tawheed — the doctrine of Divine Unity, asserting that God is absolutely One with no partners or associates; the first and most fundamental principle of Islamic theology
key_terms.فِطْرَة: fitrah — the innate nature or primordial disposition with which humans are created; connotes both the act of creation and the inherent qualities bestowed at creation

ai.seo_question: What does Quran 30:30 mean by 'the nature of Allah upon which He created mankind'?
ai.summary: A companion asks Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the meaning of the Quranic verse 30:30, which speaks of the innate nature (fitrah) upon which Allah created all people. The Imam's concise answer — 'Tawheed' (Divine Unity) — identifies the foundational human disposition as recognition of God's Oneness. This reflects a key Shia theological position: that monotheism is not merely a learned doctrine but an innate, primordial quality embedded in every human soul at creation.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said, ‘(What about) [30:30] Then set your face for the upright Religion - the nature made by Allah in which He has Made the people to be upon?’
Heasws said: ‘The Oneness (Tawheed)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “I asked ( the Imam) about the words of Allah, ‘. . . the invention of Allah (had a certain) nature with which He created all people. . . .’ [30:30]
The Imam (a.s.) said, ‘It (invention, Fitrat) refers to belief in Oneness of Allah (belief in Allah only is placed in their nature).”’
